welcome.subject: Welcome to {{appName}}
welcome.intro: We're really glad you're here. Your {{appName}} account is all set up and ready to go.
welcome.body: Take a minute to look around and make it your own. Whenever you have a question, we're just an email away.
welcome.tipBody: Open the app and finish setting up your profile — it takes less than a minute and makes everything work better for you.
welcome.closing: We're glad to have you with us.
welcome.preheader: Welcome to {{appName}} — here's how to get started.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {{appName}} password
resetPassword.preheader: A link to choose a new {{appName}} password.
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for the {{appName}} account on this email address. The button below lets you choose a new one.
resetPassword.expiry: The link works once and expires in one hour.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
